name: Will a new sliding glass door installation require any structural changes to my home?

mainEntity.name: Will a new sliding glass door installation require any structural changes to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A new sliding glass door installation may require structural changes, especially if you are altering the opening size or replacing an existing door with a different configuration, such as converting a window to a sliding door. These changes involve ensuring proper header support and integrating the new frame safely and securely into your home's structure. As a design-build firm, AKN Design Group manages all aspects of structural assessment and modification, ensuring compliance with local building codes and maintaining the integrity of your home's framework.
acceptedAnswer.description: New sliding glass door installation might need structural changes if the opening size or configuration is altered. AKN Design Group handles structural assessments and modifications.
